```{r Load Packages and Define Functions, include=FALSE}
# a function that accepts a log-log linear model, the data frame associated with the model, and a character string for the predicted variable name. Outputs the dataframe with predicted columns.
log_predict = function(lm, df, y) {
  
# call the predict function with the log-log model, and log transformed x values.
log_predicted = predict.lm(lm, df, interval = 'confidence')
df = cbind(df, log_predicted)

# make a new column that takes the anti log of the predicted values and confidence intervals
df$fit2 = 10^(df$fit)
df$lwr2 = 10^(df$lwr)
df$upr2 = 10^(df$upr)

names(df)[names(df) == 'fit'] <- glue('log_{y}_fit')
names(df)[names(df) == 'lwr'] <- glue('log_{y}_lwr')
names(df)[names(df) == 'upr'] <- glue('log_{y}_upr')

names(df)[names(df) == 'fit2'] <- glue('{y}_fit')
names(df)[names(df) == 'lwr2'] <- glue('{y}_lwr')
names(df)[names(df) == 'upr2'] <- glue('{y}_upr')

return(df)
}

# defining a VPD function using the Arden Buck equation
vpd = function(RH, Temp) {
  output = (1 - (RH/100)) * (0.61121 * exp((17.502*Temp)/(240.97+Temp)))
  return(output)
}

# defining an evaporation function. Includes unit conversions: VPD as a ratio of 1 standard atmosphere (in kPa), moles per meter squared to millimoles per meter squared, and cm squared to meters squared (conversion factor is 0.01^2).
evaporation = function(gsw, surface_area, VPD) {
  output = (VPD/101.325) * (gsw * 1000) * (surface_area * 0.0001)
  return(output)
}

# defining a function that returns climate averages for a user defined time-window using a dataframe of daily temp and VPD values.
climatenorm = function(df, envelope) {

# initializing an empty data frame
envelope_avg <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = 13, nrow = 0))
colnames(envelope_avg) <-   c('Date',glue('vpdmin_{envelope}daymean_kPa'),glue('vpdmin_{envelope}daysd_kPa'),glue('vpd_{envelope}daymean_kPa'),glue('vpd_{envelope}daysd_kPa'),glue('vpdmax_{envelope}daymean_kPa'),glue('vpdmax_{envelope}daysd_kPa'),glue('tmin_{envelope}daymean_C'),glue('tmin_{envelope}daysd_C'),glue('t_{envelope}daymean_C'),glue('t_{envelope}daysd_C'),glue('tmax_{envelope}daymean_C'),glue('tmax_{envelope}daysd_C'))

# initializing a list of datetimes
datekey = list()

# picking out the dates that match the envelope in the dataframe
for (i in (seq_len(nrow(df)))) {
  my_date = df$Date[i]
  dateprior = my_date - days(envelope)
  dateprior = c(dateprior)
  if (dateprior %in% df$Date) {
        datepick = list(my_date)
        datekey = c(datekey, datepick)
  }
}

# calculate envelope climate means and add them to the empty dataframe
for (date in datekey) {
  my_day = as_date(date)
  my_day_string = as.character(date)
  dayprior = my_day - days(envelope)
  window = df[df$Date >= dayprior & df$Date <= my_day,]
  tpool = c(window$tmin_C, window$tmax_C)
  vpdpool = c(window$vpdmin_kPa, window$vpdmax_kPa)
  envelope_avg[nrow(envelope_avg) + 1,] = c(my_day_string,mean(window$vpdmin_kPa),sd(window$vpdmin_kPa),mean(vpdpool),sd(vpdpool),mean(window$vpdmax_kPa),sd(window$vpdmax_kPa),mean(window$tmin_C),sd(window$tmin_C),mean(tpool),sd(tpool),mean(window$tmax_C),sd(window$tmax_C))
}

envelope_avg$Date = as_date(envelope_avg$Date)
output = envelope_avg
return(output)
}
```

### Petals

#### Mount Diablo Petal Surface Area and Water Content

```{r Flower Physiology Operations, include=FALSE}
petal = petal %>% mutate(p_projectedArea = p_surfaceArea)
petal = petal %>% mutate(p_surfaceArea = 2*p_surfaceArea)
petal = petal %>% mutate(p_succulence = (p_freshMass - p_dryMass) / p_projectedArea)
petal = petal %>% mutate(p_waterContentPerDryMass = (p_freshMass - p_dryMass) / p_dryMass)
petal = petal %>% mutate(p_waterMass = (p_freshMass - p_dryMass))
petal = petal %>% mutate(p_tissueMassArea = p_dryMass/p_projectedArea)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
# filtering the petal dataframe by site
petal_gh = filter(petal,location=='SFSU greenhouse')
petal_MtDiablo = filter(petal,location=='Mount Diablo')
```

```{r}
# table of petal stats for each week
petal_mean <- petal_MtDiablo %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  get_summary_stats(p_projectedArea, p_waterContentPerDryMass, type = "mean_sd")
petal_mean
```

##### One-way Analysis of Variance

```{r}
# ANOVA
petal_aov <- aov(p_projectedArea~week,data=petal_MtDiablo)
water_aov <- aov(p_waterMass~week,data=petal_MtDiablo)

# extracting petal aov summary
print('Projected Area')
petal_aov_summary = summary(petal_aov)
print(petal_aov_summary)

# extracting water aov summary
print('Absolute Water Content')
water_aov_summary = summary(water_aov)
print(water_aov_summary)
```

```{r}
petal_aov_df = petal_aov_summary[[1]]
water_aov_df = water_aov_summary[[1]]

# defining the sum of squares using the type 3 ANOVA
sumSq_groups = petal_aov_df$`Sum Sq`[1]
sumSq_error = petal_aov_df$`Sum Sq`[2]

# same for water ANOVA
sumSq_groups_water = water_aov_df$`Sum Sq`[1]
sumSq_error_water = water_aov_df$`Sum Sq`[2]

# defining R squared
petal_R2 = round((sumSq_groups / (sumSq_groups + sumSq_error)),2)
water_R2 = round((sumSq_groups_water / (sumSq_groups_water + sumSq_error_water)),2)

# printing output
print('% of projected area variation explained by time')
petal_R2
print('% of absolute water content variation explained by time')
water_R2
```

##### Testing Model Assumptions

```{r include=FALSE}
# extracting model residuals
petal_aov_res1 <- residuals(petal_aov)

# converting aov_res into a dataframe for ggplot
petal_aov_res2 <- as.data.frame(petal_aov_res1)

# histogram of model residuals
ggplot(petal_aov_res2,aes(x=petal_aov_res1)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.25)
```

```{r Petal Area Model Assumptions}
# testing normality assumptions
plot(petal_aov)

# shapiro test
shapiro.test(petal_aov_res1)

# bartlett test
bartlett.test(p_projectedArea~week, data=petal_MtDiablo)

# log 10 transformation does not pass bartlett test
bartlett.test(log10(p_projectedArea)~log10(week), data=petal_MtDiablo)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
# extracting model residuals
water_aov_res1 <- residuals(water_aov)

# converting aov_res into a dataframe for ggplot
water_aov_res2 <- as.data.frame(water_aov_res1)

# histogram of model residuals
ggplot(water_aov_res2,aes(x=water_aov_res1)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1)
```

```{r Water Content Model Assumptions}
# testing normality assumptions
plot(water_aov)

#water_aov_res3 <- petal_aov_res1[-c(54, 69, 88)]

# shapiro test
shapiro.test(water_aov_res1)

# bartlett test
bartlett.test(p_waterMass~week, data=petal_MtDiablo)

# log 10 transformation does not pass bartlett test
bartlett.test(log10(p_waterMass)~log10(week), data=petal_MtDiablo)
```

##### Pairwise Comparisons

```{r include=FALSE}
# grouping weeks by petal similarity. These groups were chosen based on Tukey HSD comparisons between weeks. The naming convention reflects the implicit assumption that petal size is a function of seasonal water availability, as the study period covered the seasonal transition from 'wet-winter' to 'dry-summer.'
endWet = 8
startDry = 10

petal_MtDiablo = petal_MtDiablo %>%
  mutate(season = case_when(week < endWet ~ 'wet',
                            week == endWet ~ 'transition',
                            week == startDry ~ 'transition',
                            week > startDry ~ 'dry')
         )
```

```{r include=FALSE}
# ANOVA for seasonal groups
petal_aov = aov(p_projectedArea~season,data=petal_MtDiablo)
summary(petal_aov)
water_aov = aov(p_waterMass~season,data=petal_MtDiablo)
```

```{r Petal Area Tukey HSD}
# Tukey test to see which dates are significantly different
t_petal <- TukeyHSD(petal_aov)
t_petal

petal_area_MtDiablo_averages = petal_MtDiablo %>% 
  group_by(season) %>%
  get_summary_stats(p_projectedArea, type = "mean_sd")

print(petal_area_MtDiablo_averages)

# Visualization of the Tukey test
plot(t_petal)
```

```{r Greenhouse Water Content Tukey HSD}
# Tukey test to see which dates are significantly different
t_water <- TukeyHSD(water_aov)
t_water

petal_water_MtDiablo_averages = petal_MtDiablo %>% 
  group_by(season) %>%
  get_summary_stats(p_waterMass, type = "mean_sd")

print(petal_water_MtDiablo_averages)

# Visualization of the Tukey test
plot(t_water)
```

#### Greenhouse Petal Surface Area and Water Content

```{r Greenhouse Irrigation System, include=FALSE}
# adding in column denoting when the greenhouse irrigation system was built

irrigationBuildWeek = as.Date("12/18/2025", "%m/%d/%Y")

petal_gh = petal_gh %>%
  mutate(water_treatment = case_when(Date <= irrigationBuildWeek ~ 'before',
                             Date > irrigationBuildWeek ~ 'after')
         )

petal_gh_before_irrigation = filter(petal_gh, water_treatment == 'before')
```

##### Linear Mixed Effects Models

```{r Linear Mixed Effects Models}
greenhouse_Apetal_lme <- lmer(p_projectedArea ~ week_of_flowering + (1 | plant), data = petal_gh)
greenhouse_Wmass_lme <- lmer(p_waterMass ~ week_of_flowering + (1 | plant), data = petal_gh)

print('Projected Area')
anova(greenhouse_Apetal_lme) 
print('Absolute Water Content')
anova(greenhouse_Wmass_lme)
```

```{r}
print("% variation in greenhouse projected area:")
petal_R2_gh = rsq.lmm(greenhouse_Apetal_lme)
petal_R2_gh = round(petal_R2_gh$model,2)
petal_R2_gh

print("% variation in greenhouse water content:")
water_R2_gh = rsq.lmm(greenhouse_Wmass_lme)
water_R2_gh = round(water_R2_gh$model,2)
water_R2_gh
```

##### Testing Model Assumptions

```{r Greenhouse Petal Area Model Assumptions}
# extracting model residuals
greenhouse_Apetal_lme_residuals = residuals(greenhouse_Apetal_lme)

# shapiro test
shapiro.test(greenhouse_Apetal_lme_residuals)

# plotting fitted vs. residuals
plot(greenhouse_Apetal_lme)

# q-q plot
qqnorm(greenhouse_Apetal_lme_residuals)
qqline(greenhouse_Apetal_lme_residuals)
```

```{r Greenhouse Water Content Model Assumptions}

greenhouse_Wmass_lme_residuals = residuals(greenhouse_Wmass_lme)

# shapiro test

# plot fitted vs. model residuals

qqline(greenhouse_Wmass_lme_residuals)
```

##### Pairwise Comparisons

```{r include=FALSE}
# grouping similar weeks together.
petal_gh = petal_gh %>%
  mutate(floral_development_period = case_when(
                            week_of_flowering < 4 & week_of_flowering > 0 ~ 'week 1 - 3',
                            week_of_flowering < 6 & week_of_flowering > 3 ~ 'week 4 - 5',
                            week_of_flowering >= 6 ~ 'week 6 - 18'
                            )
         )
```

```{r Projected Area Linear Mixed Effects Model, include=FALSE}
# Linear mixed effects model
petal_gh_lme_model <- lmer(p_projectedArea ~ floral_development_period + (1 | plant), data = petal_gh)
mass_gh_lme_model <- lmer(p_waterMass ~ floral_development_period + (1 | plant), data = petal_gh)
```

```{r Greenhouse Petal Area Tukey HSD}
# tukey test
t_gh = emmeans(petal_gh_lme_model, list(pairwise ~ floral_development_period), adjust = "tukey")

# calculating group means and standard deviations.
petal_area_gh_averages = petal_gh %>% 
  group_by(floral_development_period) %>%
  get_summary_stats(p_projectedArea, type = "mean_sd")

# output
print(petal_area_gh_averages)
t_gh
plot(t_gh)
```

```{r Water Content Tukey HSD}
# tukey test
t_mass_gh = emmeans(mass_gh_lme_model, list(pairwise ~ floral_development_period), adjust = "tukey")

# calculating group means and standard deviations.
petal_water_gh_averages = petal_gh %>% 
  group_by(floral_development_period) %>%
  get_summary_stats(p_waterMass, type = "mean_sd")

# output
print(petal_water_gh_averages)
t_mass_gh
plot(t_mass_gh)
```

#### Petal Scaling Relationships

```{r modeling Mount Diablo Petals Independently from Greenhouse Petals, include=FALSE}
petal_MtDiablo_subset = petal_MtDiablo[ , c('Date', 'plant', 'p_projectedArea', 'p_dryMass', 'p_waterMass')]
names(petal_MtDiablo_subset)[names(petal_MtDiablo_subset) == 'p_projectedArea'] <- 'p_projectedArea_MtD'
names(petal_MtDiablo_subset)[names(petal_MtDiablo_subset) == 'p_dryMass'] <- 'p_dryMass_MtD'
names(petal_MtDiablo_subset)[names(petal_MtDiablo_subset) == 'p_waterMass'] <- 'p_waterMass_MtD'
petal = merge(petal, petal_MtDiablo_subset, by = c('Date', 'plant'), all.x = TRUE)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
petal = petal %>% mutate(log_p_waterMass_MtD = log10(p_waterMass_MtD))
petal = petal %>% mutate(log_p_projectedArea_MtD = log10(p_projectedArea_MtD))
petal = petal %>% mutate(log_p_waterContentPerDryMass_MtD = log10(p_waterMass_MtD / p_dryMass_MtD))
```

```{r Petal Scaling Relationships}
print('Area and Absolute Water Content Regression')
lm_Apetal_Mh2o = lm(log_p_projectedArea_MtD~log_p_waterMass_MtD, data=petal)
summary(lm_Apetal_Mh2o)

# extracting coefficients and r-squared
Apetal_Mh2o_coeff = lm_Apetal_Mh2o$coefficients
Apetal_Mh2o_slope = round(as.numeric(Apetal_Mh2o_coeff[2]),2)
Apetal_Mh2o_intercept = round(as.numeric(Apetal_Mh2o_coeff[1]),2)
Apetal_Mh2o_R2 = round(rsq(lm_Apetal_Mh2o),2)

print('Water Content per Dry Mass and Area Regression')
lm_Wmass_Apetal = lm(log_p_waterContentPerDryMass_MtD~log_p_projectedArea_MtD, data=petal)
summary(lm_Wmass_Apetal)

# extracting coefficients and r-squared
Wmass_Apetal_coeff = lm_Wmass_Apetal$coefficients
Wmass_Apetal_slope = round(as.numeric(Wmass_Apetal_coeff[2]),2)
Wmass_Apetal_intercept = round(as.numeric(Wmass_Apetal_coeff[1]),2)
Wmass_Apetal_R2 = round(rsq(lm_Wmass_Apetal),2)
```

```{r Plant Size and Reproductive Output Scatterplot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# initializing an empty data frame
reproductive_output <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = 2, nrow = 0))
colnames(reproductive_output) <- c('rep', 'flowerTotal')

flowercount_April22 = filter(flowercount, date<as.Date('2025-04-29'))

# adding the reproductive output of each plant to the data frame
for (n in seq(1,20)) {
  f_total = sum(flowercount_April22[which(flowercount_April22$rep==n), 6])
  reproductive_output[nrow(reproductive_output) + 1,] = c(n,f_total)
}

reproductive_output = merge(reproductive_output, plantsize)
reproductive_output$radius_cm = reproductive_output$radius_m*100

radius_cm = seq(5, 30, 0.5)
radius_df = data.frame(radius_cm)
reproductive_output = merge(reproductive_output, radius_df, by = c('radius_cm'), all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# linear regression
reproductive_output_lm = lm(log10(flowerTotal)~log10(radius_cm), data = reproductive_output)
print('Observed whole plant flower production and plant radius linear regression')
summary(reproductive_output_lm)

# glm with a zero-truncated Poisson distribution
reproductive_output_glm = glm(flowerTotal~radius_cm, family = Tpoisson(), data = reproductive_output)
check_overdispersion(reproductive_output_glm)

# negative binomial with glm.nb
reproductive_output_glm.nb = glm.nb(flowerTotal~radius_cm, data = reproductive_output)
AIC(reproductive_output_glm.nb,reproductive_output_lm)

# zero-truncated negative binomial with vglm
reproductive_output_vglm = vglm(flowerTotal~radius_cm, family = posnegbinomial(), data = reproductive_output)
AIC(reproductive_output_vglm)

# truncated negative binomial with glmmTMB
reproductive_output_glmmTMB = glmmTMB(flowerTotal~radius_cm, family = truncated_nbinom1, data = reproductive_output)
AIC(reproductive_output_glmmTMB, reproductive_output_lm)

# extracting coefficients and r-squared
repro_output_coeff = reproductive_output_lm$coefficients
repro_output_slope = round(as.numeric(repro_output_coeff[2]),2)
repro_output_intercept = round(as.numeric(repro_output_coeff[1]),2)
repro_output_R2 = round(rsq(reproductive_output_lm),2)

#flower_predict = predict.glm(reproductive_output_glm.nb, reproductive_output, se.fit = TRUE)
#flower_fit_se = data.frame(flower_predict$fit,flower_predict$se.fit)
#reproductive_output = cbind(reproductive_output, flower_fit_se)

# predicting total flowers from plant size
reproductive_output = log_predict(reproductive_output_lm, reproductive_output, 'flowerTotal')
```

### Climate

```{r Calculating VPD, include=FALSE}
atmosphere$VPD = vpd(atmosphere$Humidity..rh.,atmosphere$Celsius.C.)
```

```{r Daylight Savings Correction, include=FALSE}
# initializing the data frame and defining delayed DST
atmosphere_noDST = atmosphere
delayed_DST = ymd_hms("2025-3-11T9:38:00") 

# daylight savings correction. DST starts after March 11 9:38am in the atmosphere dataframe due to delayed timestamp update.
for (i in (seq_len(nrow(atmosphere_noDST)))) {
  my_datetime = atmosphere_noDST[i,1]
  if (my_datetime > delayed_DST) {
    atmosphere_noDST[i,1] = my_datetime - hours(1)
    atmosphere_noDST[i,9] = hms::as_hms(my_datetime - hours(1))
  }
}
```

#### PRISM Regression

```{r Time Zone Management, include=FALSE}
# removing handheld sensor data from atmosphere_noDST
atmosphere_UTC = filter(atmosphere_noDST, Comments != 'Vaisala hand-held')

# adding UTC timestamp column
atmosphere_UTC$UTC = atmosphere_UTC$Time + hours(8)

# adding a UTC date column
atmosphere_UTC$UTC_Date = as_date(atmosphere_UTC$UTC)

# adding a PRISM timestamp column
atmosphere_UTC$PRISM_timestamp = atmosphere_UTC$UTC + hours(12)

# adding a PRISM date column
atmosphere_UTC$PRISM_Date = as_date(atmosphere_UTC$PRISM_timestamp)

# converting to character
atmosphere_UTC$UTC_Date = as.character(atmosphere_UTC$UTC_Date)
atmosphere_UTC$PRISM_Date = as.character(atmosphere_UTC$PRISM_Date)
```

```{r PRISM Regression, include=FALSE}
# filtering out incomplete PRISM days
atmosphere_UTC = subset(atmosphere_UTC, !(PRISM_Date %in% c('2025-03-05','2025-03-26','2025-04-09','2025-04-16','2025-04-23','2025-07-03')))

#calculating VPD daily mean and standard deviation from the EZlog data
UTC_VPD_mean <- atmosphere_UTC %>%
  group_by(PRISM_Date) %>%
  get_summary_stats(VPD, type = c("full"))

#merging by date
UTC_VPD_mean$Date = UTC_VPD_mean$PRISM_Date
#UTC_VPD_mean$Date = as_date(UTC_VPD_mean$Date)
prism_UTC_merge = merge(prism, UTC_VPD_mean, by = c("Date"), all.x = TRUE)

#converting units
prism_UTC_merge$vpdmax..kPa. = 0.1 * prism_UTC_merge$vpdmax..hPa.
prism_UTC_merge$vpdmin..kPa. = 0.1 * prism_UTC_merge$vpdmin..hPa.

#defining PRISM VPD mean
prism_UTC_merge$vpdmean..kPa. = (prism_UTC_merge$vpdmax..kPa. + prism_UTC_merge$vpdmin..kPa)/2

#defining the columns to statistical min and max
names(prism_UTC_merge)[names(prism_UTC_merge) == 'min'] <- 'EZlog_vpdmin'
names(prism_UTC_merge)[names(prism_UTC_merge) == 'max'] <- 'EZlog_vpdmax'

#calculating values using the linear models. Model without a number only used mean and max values before April 24.
#Model 2 for min, max and mean used the whole dataset. 
#Used model 2 for vpdmin, restricting data to before April 24 makes R square too low.
#Models 3 and 4 for min and max modeled EZ log standard deviation rather than minimum and maximum values.
prism_UTC_merge$model2_vpdmin = (0.65510 * prism_UTC_merge$vpdmin..kPa.) + 0.05115
prism_UTC_merge$model3_vpdmin = (0.18700 * prism_UTC_merge$vpdmin..kPa.) + 0.02288
prism_UTC_merge$model4_vpdmin = (1.02829 * prism_UTC_merge$vpdmin..kPa.) + 0.01484
prism_UTC_merge$model_vpdmean = (1.34005 * prism_UTC_merge$vpdmean..kPa.) - 0.07902
prism_UTC_merge$model2_vpdmean = (1.59790 * prism_UTC_merge$vpdmean..kPa.) + 0.04487
prism_UTC_merge$model_vpdmax = (2.1405 * prism_UTC_merge$vpdmax..kPa.) - 0.2163
prism_UTC_merge$model2_vpdmax = (2.10387 * prism_UTC_merge$vpdmax..kPa.) + 0.50231
prism_UTC_merge$model3_vpdmax = (1.56964 * prism_UTC_merge$vpdmax..kPa.) - 0.26105
prism_UTC_merge$model4_vpdmax = (1.66983 * prism_UTC_merge$vpdmax..kPa.) + 0.09562

ggplot(prism_UTC_merge, aes(x=Date,y=mean)) + 
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=EZlog_vpdmin), color = 'darkblue', show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=model2_vpdmin), linetype = 2, color = 'blue') +
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=vpdmin..kPa.), linetype = 2, color = 'lightblue') +
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=EZlog_vpdmax), color = 'red') +
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=model_vpdmax), linetype = 2, color = 'orange') +
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=mean)) +
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=model_vpdmean), linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=vpdmean..kPa.), linetype = 3) +
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=model2_vpdmean), linetype = 4) +
  labs(title = 'Actual climate data compared with modeled data', y = 'Vapor pressure deficit (kPa)')

ggplot(prism_UTC_merge, aes(x=Date,y=mean)) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = EZlog_vpdmin, ymax = EZlog_vpdmax), fill = "lightgrey") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = vpdmin..kPa., ymax = vpdmax..kPa.), fill = "grey70") +
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=mean)) +
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=vpdmean..kPa.), linetype = 2)+
  labs(title = 'PRISM average daily VPD comparison', y = 'Vapor pressure deficit (kPa)')

# maybe model a shorter timespan, where PRISM data is more accurate?
prism_vpd_model_data = filter(prism_UTC_merge, Date < mdy('4/24/2025'))
```

```{r include=FALSE}
#calculating temperature daily mean and standard deviation from the EZlog data
UTC_temp_mean <- atmosphere_UTC %>%

names(prism_UTC_temp_merge)[names(prism_UTC_temp_merge) == 'max'] <- 'EZlog_tmax'

prism_UTC_temp_merge$model2_tmin = (0.88055 * prism_UTC_temp_merge$tmin..degrees.C.) - 0.35062

prism_UTC_temp_merge$model2_tmean = (1.22061 * prism_UTC_temp_merge$tmean..degrees.C.) - 0.44046
prism_UTC_temp_merge$model_tmax = (1.4160 * prism_UTC_temp_merge$tmax..degrees.C.) + 0.3717
prism_UTC_temp_merge$model2_tmax = (1.22061 * prism_UTC_temp_merge$tmax..degrees.C.) - 0.44046
prism_UTC_temp_merge$model3_tmax = (1.28423 * prism_UTC_temp_merge$tmax..degrees.C.) - 1.92625
prism_UTC_temp_merge$model4_tmax = (1.24998 * prism_UTC_temp_merge$tmax..degrees.C.) + 0.21295

  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=mean)) +
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=tmean..degrees.C.), linetype = 2)+
  labs(title = 'PRISM average daily temperature comparison', y = 'Temperature (degrees C)')

ggplot(prism_UTC_temp_merge, aes(x=Date,y=mean)) +

  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=model_tmin), linetype = 2, color = 'blue') +
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=model2_tmin), linetype = 2, color = 'lightblue') +
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=EZlog_tmax), color = 'red') +
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=model_tmax), linetype = 2, color = 'orange') +
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=mean)) +
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=model_tmean), linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=tmean..degrees.C.), linetype = 3) +
  geom_line(aes(x=Date,y=model2_tmean), linetype = 4) +
  labs(title = 'Actual climate data compared with modeled data', y = 'Temperature (degrees C)')

# maybe model a shorter timespan, where PRISM data is more accurate?
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
prism_model = p15 + p16 + plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')

export_png('figures/prism_model.png', prism_model)
```

```{r Recovering Lost Climate Data, include=FALSE}
# defining a new dataframe for daily average VPD and renaming columns
atmosphere_dailyavg_vpd = prism_UTC_merge
names(atmosphere_dailyavg_vpd)[names(atmosphere_dailyavg_vpd) == 'mean'] <- 'EZlog_vpdmean'
names(atmosphere_dailyavg_vpd)[names(atmosphere_dailyavg_vpd) == 'sd'] <- 'EZlog_vpd_sd'
names(atmosphere_dailyavg_vpd)[names(atmosphere_dailyavg_vpd) == 'n'] <- 'EZlog_vpd_n'
atmosphere_dailyavg_vpd$variable = NULL
atmosphere_dailyavg_vpd$median = NULL
atmosphere_dailyavg_vpd$q1 = NULL
atmosphere_dailyavg_vpd$q3 = NULL
atmosphere_dailyavg_vpd$iqr = NULL
atmosphere_dailyavg_vpd$mad = NULL
atmosphere_dailyavg_vpd$se = NULL
atmosphere_dailyavg_vpd$ci = NULL

# defining a new dataframe for daily average temperatures and renaming columns
atmosphere_dailyavg_temp = prism_UTC_temp_merge
names(atmosphere_dailyavg_temp)[names(atmosphere_dailyavg_temp) == 'mean'] <- 'EZlog_tmean'
names(atmosphere_dailyavg_temp)[names(atmosphere_dailyavg_temp) == 'sd'] <- 'EZlog_t_sd'
names(atmosphere_dailyavg_temp)[names(atmosphere_dailyavg_temp) == 'n'] <- 'EZlog_t_n'
atmosphere_dailyavg_temp$variable = NULL
atmosphere_dailyavg_temp$median = NULL
atmosphere_dailyavg_temp$q1 = NULL
atmosphere_dailyavg_temp$q3 = NULL
atmosphere_dailyavg_temp$iqr = NULL
atmosphere_dailyavg_temp$mad = NULL
atmosphere_dailyavg_temp$se = NULL
atmosphere_dailyavg_temp$ci = NULL

# merging daily average atmospheric measurements into a new dataframe
atmosphere_dailyavg = merge(atmosphere_dailyavg_vpd, atmosphere_dailyavg_temp, by = c('Date', 'ppt..mm.','tmin..degrees.C.','tmean..degrees.C.','tmax..degrees.C.','tdmean..degrees.C.','vpdmin..hPa.','vpdmax..hPa.','Comments','PRISM_Date'))

# renaming date columns. PST is 20 hours behind PRISM time.
atmosphere_dailyavg$PRISM_Date = NULL
names(atmosphere_dailyavg)[names(atmosphere_dailyavg) == 'Date'] <- 'PRISM_Date'
#atmosphere_dailyavg$PRISM_Date = as_date(atmosphere_dailyavg$PRISM_Date)
atmosphere_dailyavg$Date = atmosphere_dailyavg$PRISM_Date - day(1)

# renaming columns to specify PRISM data sources
names(atmosphere_dailyavg)[names(atmosphere_dailyavg) == 'ppt..mm.'] <- 'PRISM_ppt_mm'
names(atmosphere_dailyavg)[names(atmosphere_dailyavg) == 'tmin..degrees.C.'] <- 'PRISM_tmin_C'
names(atmosphere_dailyavg)[names(atmosphere_dailyavg) == 'tmean..degrees.C.'] <- 'PRISM_tmean_C'
names(atmosphere_dailyavg)[names(atmosphere_dailyavg) == 'tmax..degrees.C.'] <- 'PRISM_tmax_C'
names(atmosphere_dailyavg)[names(atmosphere_dailyavg) == 'tdmean..degrees.C.'] <- 'PRISM_tdmean_C'
names(atmosphere_dailyavg)[names(atmosphere_dailyavg) == 'vpdmin..hPa.'] <- 'PRISM_vpdmin_hPa'
names(atmosphere_dailyavg)[names(atmosphere_dailyavg) == 'vpdmax..hPa.'] <- 'PRISM_vpdmax_hPa'
names(atmosphere_dailyavg)[names(atmosphere_dailyavg) == 'vpdmin..kPa.'] <- 'PRISM_vpdmin_kPa'
names(atmosphere_dailyavg)[names(atmosphere_dailyavg) == 'vpdmean..kPa.'] <- 'PRISM_vpdmean_kPa'
names(atmosphere_dailyavg)[names(atmosphere_dailyavg) == 'vpdmax..kPa.'] <- 'PRISM_vpdmax_kPa'

# defining new columns for concatenating different data sources
atmosphere_dailyavg$vpdmin_kPa = atmosphere_dailyavg$EZlog_vpdmin
atmosphere_dailyavg$vpdmean_kPa = atmosphere_dailyavg$EZlog_vpdmean
atmosphere_dailyavg$vpdmax_kPa = atmosphere_dailyavg$EZlog_vpdmax
atmosphere_dailyavg$tmin_C = atmosphere_dailyavg$EZlog_tmin
atmosphere_dailyavg$tmean_C = atmosphere_dailyavg$EZlog_tmean
atmosphere_dailyavg$tmax_C = atmosphere_dailyavg$EZlog_tmax
atmosphere_dailyavg$data_source = atmosphere_dailyavg$Comments
atmosphere_dailyavg$location = 'Mount Diablo'

# filling in null EZ log values with values from the climate models developed with PRISM data.
# I ended up using the second model for the VPD minimum values. Which model is used can be adjusted with the 'model' variable in the for loop.
for (i in (seq_len(nrow(atmosphere_dailyavg)))) {
  compiled = atmosphere_dailyavg[i,c("vpdmin_kPa","vpdmean_kPa","vpdmax_kPa","tmin_C","tmean_C","tmax_C")]
  model = atmosphere_dailyavg[i,c("model2_vpdmin","model_vpdmean","model_vpdmax","model_tmin","model_tmean","model_tmax")]
  #data_source = atmosphere_dailyavg[i,42]
  if (is.na(compiled[1,1]) == TRUE) {
    atmosphere_dailyavg[i,c("vpdmin_kPa","vpdmean_kPa","vpdmax_kPa","tmin_C","tmean_C","tmax_C")] = model
    atmosphere_dailyavg$data_source[i] = 'PRISM climate model'
  } else {
      atmosphere_dailyavg$data_source[i] = 'On-site sensor'
    }
}
```

#### Petal Area and Climate Scatterplot

```{r Petal Size and Climate Linear Model, include=FALSE}
# make petal mean into individual observations

petal_mean <- petal %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  get_summary_stats(p_projectedArea, type = "mean_sd")

Wmass_mean <- petal %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  get_summary_stats(p_waterMass, type = "mean_sd")

climate_normals10 = climatenorm(atmosphere_dailyavg, 10)

# swap in a merge here using the climatenorm function output
petal_climate10 = merge(petal_mean, climate_normals10, all.y = TRUE, by = c("Date"))
Wmass_climate10 = merge(Wmass_mean, climate_normals10, all.y = TRUE, by = c("Date"))

petal_climate10_model_input = merge(petal_MtDiablo, climate_normals10, all.y = TRUE, by = c("Date"))

petal_climate10_model_input$vpdmax_10daymean_kPa = as.numeric(petal_climate10_model_input$vpdmax_10daymean_kPa)

# log transforming for 10 day climate normal data 
petal_climate10_model_input$log_vpdmax_10daymean_kPa = log10(petal_climate10_model_input$vpdmax_10daymean_kPa)

petal_climate10_model_input$log_p_projectedArea = log10(petal_climate10_model_input$p_projectedArea)

petal_climate10_model_input$log_p_waterMass = log10(petal_climate10_model_input$p_waterMass)

# linear models
VPD_petal_lm = lm(log_p_projectedArea~log_vpdmax_10daymean_kPa, data=petal_climate10_model_input)

VPD_Wmass_lm = lm(log_p_waterMass~log_vpdmax_10daymean_kPa, data=petal_climate10_model_input)
```

```{r}
print("VPD and petal area linear regression")
summary(VPD_petal_lm)

# extracting coefficients and r-squared
VPD_petal_R2 = round(rsq(VPD_petal_lm), 2)
VPD_petal_coeff = VPD_petal_lm$coefficients
VPD_petal_slope = round(as.numeric(VPD_petal_coeff[2]),2)
VPD_petal_intercept = round(as.numeric(VPD_petal_coeff[1]),2)

print("VPD and petal absolute water content linear regression")
summary(VPD_Wmass_lm)

# extracting coefficients and r-squared
VPD_Wmass_R2 = round(rsq(VPD_Wmass_lm), 2)
VPD_Wmass_coeff = VPD_Wmass_lm$coefficients
VPD_Wmass_slope = round(as.numeric(VPD_Wmass_coeff[2]),2)
VPD_Wmass_intercept = round(as.numeric(VPD_Wmass_coeff[1]),2)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
# call the predict function with the log-log model, and log transformed x values.
VPD_predict_log_p_projectedArea_MtD = predict.lm(VPD_petal_lm, petal_climate10_model_input, interval = 'confidence')
petal_climate10_model_input = cbind(petal_climate10_model_input, VPD_predict_log_p_projectedArea_MtD)
names(petal_climate10_model_input)[names(petal_climate10_model_input) == 'fit'] <- 'log_p_projectedArea_fit'
names(petal_climate10_model_input)[names(petal_climate10_model_input) == 'lwr'] <- 'log_p_projectedArea_lwr'
names(petal_climate10_model_input)[names(petal_climate10_model_input) == 'upr'] <- 'log_p_projectedArea_upr'

# do the same as above for Wmass
VPD_predict_log_p_waterMass_MtD = predict.lm(VPD_Wmass_lm, petal_climate10_model_input, interval = 'confidence')
petal_climate10_model_input = cbind(petal_climate10_model_input, VPD_predict_log_p_waterMass_MtD)
names(petal_climate10_model_input)[names(petal_climate10_model_input) == 'fit'] <- 'log_p_waterMass_fit'
names(petal_climate10_model_input)[names(petal_climate10_model_input) == 'lwr'] <- 'log_p_waterMass_lwr'
names(petal_climate10_model_input)[names(petal_climate10_model_input) == 'upr'] <- 'log_p_waterMass_upr'

# make a new column that takes the anti log of the predicted values and confidence intervals
petal_climate10_model_input$p_projectedArea_fit = 10^(petal_climate10_model_input$log_p_projectedArea_fit)
petal_climate10_model_input$p_projectedArea_lwr = 10^(petal_climate10_model_input$log_p_projectedArea_lwr)
petal_climate10_model_input$p_projectedArea_upr = 10^(petal_climate10_model_input$log_p_projectedArea_upr)

# do the same as above for Wmass
petal_climate10_model_input$p_waterMass_fit = 10^(petal_climate10_model_input$log_p_waterMass_fit)
petal_climate10_model_input$p_waterMass_lwr = 10^(petal_climate10_model_input$log_p_waterMass_lwr)
petal_climate10_model_input$p_waterMass_upr = 10^(petal_climate10_model_input$log_p_waterMass_upr)
```

```{r Calculating Total gs}
# formatting the dates consistently
porometer <- porometer %>% 
  mutate(Date = parse_date_time(Date, 
orders = c("mdy", "Ymd")))

# filter porometer by petal side
gsw_ab = filter(porometer,Petal.side=="bottom")
colnames(gsw_ab)[7] <- 'gsw_bottom'
nrow(gsw_ab)
gsw_ad = filter(porometer,Petal.side=="top")
colnames(gsw_ad)[7] <- 'gsw_top'
nrow(gsw_ad)

# merging the top and bottom petal gsw to get total surface conductance
# used the time stamp for the abaxial measurement, since it was usually taken first.
gsw_ab_select = gsw_ab %>% select('Time', 'Date', 'remark', 'Sample', 'location', 'gsw_bottom', 'Tref', 'plant')
gsw_ad_select = gsw_ad %>% select('Date', 'remark', 'Sample', 'gsw_top', 'plant')
porometer_gsw_total = NULL
porometer_gsw_total = merge(gsw_ab_select, gsw_ad_select, by = c("Date","remark","Sample","plant"))
porometer_gsw_total = porometer_gsw_total %>% mutate(gswTotal = gsw_bottom + gsw_top)

nrow(porometer_gsw_total)
nrow(filter(porometer_gsw_total, gsw_bottom < 0))
nrow(filter(porometer_gsw_total, gsw_top < 0))

# porometer timestamp is in pacific standard time, never updated to daylight savings. 
# Other than that consideration, porometer measurements were only a few minutes ahead from my phone clock if I recall. No further adjustments are necessary.

# converting date and time columns into a datetime column
porometer_gsw_total$Datetime = ymd_hms(paste(porometer_gsw_total$Date, porometer_gsw_total$Time))

# filtering out zero values and values greater than 0.025 mol per meter squared per second.
before_outliers = nrow(porometer_gsw_total)
porometer_gsw_total = filter(porometer_gsw_total,gswTotal<0.025)
after_outliers1 = nrow(porometer_gsw_total)
porometer_gsw_total = filter(porometer_gsw_total,gswTotal!=0)
after_outliers2 = nrow(porometer_gsw_total)

# separating greenhouse measurements from field measurments
porometer_gsw_total_gh = filter(porometer_gsw_total,location=='SFSU greenhouse')
porometer_gsw_total = filter(porometer_gsw_total,location=='Mount Diablo')

mean(porometer_gsw_total$gswTotal)
sd(porometer_gsw_total$gswTotal)
median(porometer_gsw_total$gswTotal)

titleFig3 <- expression(paste("Histogram of total surface conductance for 491 ", italic("Eschscholzia californica"), " petals"))

ggplot(porometer_gsw_total,aes(x=gswTotal)) + 
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.001) +
  labs(title = 'Figure 3', subtitle = titleFig3, x = "Total petal surface conductance", y = "Count") #+
  #lims(x = c(0, 0.05))
```

#### Modeling Midday Water Loss

```{r Calculating Mean Midday Temp and VPD, include=FALSE}
# initializing an empty data frame
midday_climate <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = 5, nrow = 0))
colnames(midday_climate) <- c('Date', 'mean_midday_temp', 'mean_midday_rh', 'mean_midday_dew', 'mean_midday_VPD')

#initializing a list of datetimes
midday_datekey = list()

# picking out the sampling dates with midday data
for (i in (seq_len(nrow(atmosphere_noDST)))) {
  my_datetime = atmosphere_noDST[i,1]
  time = atmosphere_noDST[i,9]
  if (time < hms::as_hms(41400) & time >= hms::as_hms(39600)) {
    datepick = list(my_datetime)
    midday_datekey = c(midday_datekey, datepick)
    }
}

# calculate midday climate and add it to the empty dataframe
for (datetime in midday_datekey) {
  my_day = as_date(datetime)
  my_day_string = as.character(my_day)
  datetime_plus1.5hr = datetime + hours(1) + minutes(30)
  midday_window = atmosphere_noDST[atmosphere_noDST$Time >= datetime & atmosphere_noDST$Time <= datetime_plus1.5hr,]
  midday_climate[nrow(midday_climate) + 1,] = c(my_day_string,mean(midday_window$Celsius.C.),mean(midday_window$Humidity..rh.),mean(midday_window$Dew.Point.C.),mean(midday_window$VPD))
}

midday_climate$Date = as_date(midday_climate$Date)

# can I recover 3/25 and 4/15 by modeling prior day midday VPD?
midday_climate_March24 = filter(midday_climate, Date == "2025-03-24")
midday_climate_April14 = filter(midday_climate, Date == "2025-04-14")
midday_climate_priorDay = rbind(midday_climate_March24, midday_climate_April14)
midday_climate_priorDay$priorDay = 'yes'
midday_climate_priorDay$Date = midday_climate_priorDay$Date + day(1)
midday_climate$priorDay = 'no'

midday_climate = rbind(midday_climate, midday_climate_priorDay)
midday_climate
```

```{r Modeling Midday Water Loss, include=FALSE}
# Merging Mount Diablo gs Observations with their Petals
petal_complete = merge(petal_MtDiablo, porometer_gsw_total, by = c("Date", "week", "plant", "location"), all.x = TRUE)

petal_complete$Date = as_date(petal_complete$Date)
petal_complete_midday_climate = merge(petal_complete, midday_climate, by = c("Date"), all.x = TRUE)

petal_complete_midday_climate$mean_midday_VPD = as.numeric(petal_complete_midday_climate$mean_midday_VPD)
petal_complete_midday_climate$mean_midday_temp = as.numeric(petal_complete_midday_climate$mean_midday_temp)

# calling the evaporation function. Multiplying projected area by 4 for whole flower waterloss.
petal_complete_midday_climate$evaporation = evaporation(petal_complete_midday_climate$gswTotal, (petal_complete_midday_climate$p_projectedArea*4), petal_complete_midday_climate$mean_midday_VPD)

# calculating water loss in millimoles by multiplying evaporation by 2 hours (in seconds).
petal_complete_midday_climate$total_midday_waterloss = petal_complete_midday_climate$evaporation * 2 * 60 * 60

# converting millimoles to moles and then to grams
petal_complete_midday_climate$total_midday_waterloss_g = ((petal_complete_midday_climate$evaporation * 2 * 60 * 60) / 1000) * 18

# converting grams to milligrams
petal_complete_midday_climate$total_midday_waterloss_mg = (petal_complete_midday_climate$total_midday_waterloss_g)*1000

ggplot(petal_complete_midday_climate,aes(x=evaporation)) + 
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.00001)
```

```{r include=FALSE}

```

```{r}

print("Waterloss and Time Linear Regression")

waterloss_vpd_R2 = round(rsq(waterloss_vpd_lm),2)
```

```{r Surface Conductance Figure}
range(porometer_VPD$mean_midday_VPD)

vpd_lim2 = md_vpd_max + (md_vpd_max - md_vpd_min)*0.05

md_t_min = min(porometer_VPD$mean_midday_temp)
md_t_max = max(porometer_VPD$mean_midday_temp)

t_lim2 = md_t_max + (md_t_max - md_t_min)*0.05

p7 = ggplot(petal_gsw_gh, aes(x = week_of_flowering, y = gswTotal_mean*1000)) +
  geom_point() +
  #geom_smooth(method = 'lm', se = TRUE) +
  labs(x = "Week of flowering", y = NULL) +
  annotate("text", x = 18, y = 25, label = "n.s.") +

  annotate('rect', xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = gs_mean_gh - gs_sd_gh, ymax = gs_mean_gh + gs_sd_gh, alpha = .1) +
  theme_classic() +
  ylim(0,25) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.15,18.85), expand = expansion(mult = 0), breaks = c(5,10,15)) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_markdown())

p8 = ggplot(porometer_gsw_total, aes(x = week, y = gswTotal*1000)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  #geom_smooth(method = 'lm', se = TRUE) +
  labs(x = 'Week of field study', y = "<i>g<sub>s, total</sub></i> (mmol m<sup>-2</sup> s<sup>-1</sup>)") +
  annotate("text", x = 18, y = 25, label = "n.s.") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = gs_mean_MtD, color = 'blue', linetype = 5) +
  annotate('rect', xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = gs_mean_MtD - gs_sd_MtD, ymax = gs_mean_MtD + gs_sd_MtD, alpha = .1) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.15,18.85), expand = expansion(mult = 0), breaks = c(5,10,15)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_markdown())

p9 = ggplot(porometer_VPD, aes(x = mean_midday_VPD, y = gswTotal*1000)) +
  geom_point() +
  #geom_smooth(method="lm",se=TRUE) +
  labs(y = "<i>g<sub>s, total</sub></i> (mmol m<sup>-2</sup> s<sup>-1</sup>)", x = "Mean midday VPD (kPa)") +
  annotate("text", x = 5.62, y = 25, label = "n.s.") +

  annotate('rect', xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = gs_mean_MtD - gs_sd_MtD, ymax = gs_mean_MtD + gs_sd_MtD, alpha = .1) +
```
